title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-10

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with solid clarity delivers a wildly energetic show highlighted by a standout Morning Dew and Black Peter, despite a rough first half.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its nice, clear sound – likely a sound‑board source – that lets the high‑octane performance shine. Reviewers rave about the “fucking ragin flow,” the unorthodox arrangement of Morning Dew, and a memorable Black Peter, while noting the first half feels a bit rough before building to a brilliant finish with guest Stephen Stills.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high energy, standout songs) weighted heavily; recording quality is good but not flawless, leading to an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the sound as "nice" and clear, though one reviewer calls the first half rough; no major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Ragged and vocal‑focused first half gives way to a brilliant, high‑energy second half with unusual arrangements and guest Stephen Stills adding jug‑band flair.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned jamming with Stephen Stills in a jug‑band style; his playing is highlighted as part of the unorthodox Dew arrangement.
